name: Staff of Fire

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

last.text: blackens, crumbles into cinders and is destroyed

summary: Resistance to Fire; 10 charges: Burning Hands (1), Fireball (3), Wall of Fire (4) at your DC.
text: Holding this staff grants Resistance to Fire damage. Its 10 charges power spells cast with your spell save DC: Wall of Fire (4 charges), Fireball (3 charges) or Burning Hands (1 charge). It recovers 1d6 + 4 charges each dawn. Spending its final charge calls for a 1d20 roll, and a 1 means the staff chars black, falls apart into cinders and is destroyed.
